test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following sports is 'Bishop' used?
solution:
The correct answer is **Chess.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **golden rule of chess **is a piece is safe only as long as it is defended by the same number of pieces that are attacking it.
 
• If your opponent attacks one of your pieces, count the number of your pieces that defend it immediately to make sure that it is safe.
 
• The **fifty-move rule **in chess states that a player can claim a draw if no capture has been made and no pawn has been moved in the last fifty consecutive moves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The name snooker comes from a comment chamberlain made about a player who missed a shot.
 
• Baseball is a bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each.
 
• Billiards, any of various games played on a rectangular table with a designated number of small balls and a long stick called a cue.
